QuestInfo.name: Horny Mushroom Caps Research
QuestInfo.0: Apparently, the #bThe Rememberer#k of Sleepywood is conducting studies on mutated Horny Mushrooms. You should go to Sleepywood to find out more.
QuestInfo.1:
Some Horny Mushrooms have been acting really cruelly lately...there seems to be something suspicious going on. #bThe Rememberer#k has noticed the change and is conducting studies on these suspicious Horny Mushrooms.


#i4000015:# #t4000015:# #c4000015# / 30
QuestInfo.2: You helped #bThe Rememberer#k with his research on Horny Mushrooms, but he seems to need some more information.

0.0: Have you seen the Horny Mushrooms lately? They seem to be much more enraged than usual. From what I hear, something happened at the Mushroom Castle. I plan on conducting a thorough research on the Horny Mushrooms. Can you help me with it?

yes.0: Thank you. I'll need 30 Horny Mushroom Caps to start things off. Can you get me those?

no.0: This is just the tip of the iceberg. There's no way to tell what's going to happen next...

1.0: Thank you. These will help me with my research. Please wait for me for a bit, okay?
